# ScriptServerDisplayForm

*Server*

A BBS form rendered in the world for selected players, at a world position or relative to an entity. Create it with `world.createDisplayForm(form)` (world position) or `entity.createDisplayForm(form)`

(relative to the entity), configure it and call [`show()`](#show). Every property can also be changed while the display is shown: changes are sent to viewers once at the end of the server tick, position and transform changes are interpolated. Shown displays are kept until [`remove()`](#remove), the end of their lifetime, the death of a non-player anchor or server stop. Find a shown display from another script with `c.getServer().getDisplayForm(id)`.

`player.createDisplayForm()` displays that player's live form and existing animations instead of a copy. Call methods on the server thread (server scripts and schedules run there).

```js
var form = scram.form('{"id":"bbs:mob","mobId":"minecraft:pig"}');
var display = c.getPlayer().createDisplayForm("halo", form)
    .setPosition(0, 2.2, 0)
    .setThroughWalls(true)
    .setWorldLighting(false)
    .show();
```

## Methods

### getDisplay {#getdisplay}

::: member

**Returns** `ServerDisplayForm` — the internal server display; changes made through it bypass the validation of this wrapper

:::

### getId {#getid}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — display ID: the one given on creation, or a random UUID.

:::

### show {#show}

::: member

Shows the display to its viewers and starts its lifetime from zero. Does nothing if it is already shown. A shown display with the same ID is removed first. A removed display can be shown again.

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### remove {#remove}

::: member

Removes the display from all viewers before its lifetime ends. Does nothing if it is not shown.

:::

### isShown {#isshown}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the display is shown: neither removed nor expired

:::

### setForm {#setform}

::: member

Replaces the displayed form. The form is copied: later changes of the given form are not applied until it is set again. A display created with `player.createDisplayForm()` stops using the player's live form.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `form` | [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) | form to display, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### getForm {#getform}

::: member

**Returns** [`BBSForm`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSForm) — copy of the displayed form, or null if the live player has no form or is not loaded; change it and pass it to [`setForm(BBSForm)`](#setform) to use the edited copy instead of the live form

:::

### isUsingAnchorForm {#isusinganchorform}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if this display uses its player anchor's current form and animation state

:::

### setPosition {#setposition}

::: member

Sets the position: world coordinates for a world display, an offset in blocks for an entity display.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | X coordinate or offset |
| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Y coordinate or offset |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | Z coordinate or offset |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### setPosition {#setposition-2}

::: member

Sets the position from a vector, see [`setPosition(double, double, double)`](#setposition).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) | position, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### getPosition {#getposition}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — world coordinates, or the offset from the anchor entity

:::

### setTransform {#settransform}

::: member

Sets the transform applied after the position: translation in blocks, rotation in radians, scale. The transform is copied.

| `transform` | [`BBSTransform`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSTransform) | transform, not null; see `scram.createTransform()` |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### getTransform {#gettransform}

::: member

**Returns** [`BBSTransform`](/scripting/common/bbs/BBSTransform) — copy of the transform; change it and pass it to [`setTransform(BBSTransform)`](#settransform) to apply changes

:::

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

### setAnchor {#setanchor}

::: member

Places the display relative to an entity: the position becomes an offset from the entity's feet. The display follows the entity across respawns and dimension changes; it is removed when a non-player anchor dies or despawns, and is not rendered while the anchor is not loaded on the viewer's client.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `ScriptServerEntity<?>` | anchor entity, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### getAnchor {#getanchor}

::: member

**Returns** `ScriptServerEntity<?>` — anchor entity, or null for a world display or an anchor that is not loaded

:::

### hasAnchor {#hasanchor}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the display is placed relative to an entity

:::

### setWorld {#setworld}

::: member

Places the display at a world position in the given world, detaching it from its anchor. The position becomes world coordinates.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `world` | [`ScriptServerWorld`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerWorld) | world, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### getDimension {#getdimension}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — world registry key, e.g. minecraft:overworld: the display world, or the anchor's last known world

:::

::: member

Sets how long the display is shown after [`show()`](#show).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | lifetime in ticks; 0 (default) shows the display until it is removed |

:::

### getLifetime {#getlifetime}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — lifetime in ticks, 0 for an infinite display

:::

### getAge {#getage}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — ticks since the display was shown

:::

### setInterpolation {#setinterpolation}

::: member

Sets how smoothly position and transform changes are applied on clients.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | interpolation duration in ticks; 0 applies changes immediately; default 1, smooth for per-tick updates |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### getInterpolation {#getinterpolation}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — interpolation duration in ticks

:::

### isHiddenInFirstPerson {#ishiddeninfirstperson}

:::

### setGlobal {#setglobal}

::: member

Shows the display to every online player, including players who join later, or only to the viewers.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `global` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | true (default) for every player, false for viewers only |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### isGlobal {#isglobal}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if every player sees the display

:::

### addViewer {#addviewer}

::: member

Adds a viewer and makes the display private (`setGlobal(false)`): only viewers see it afterwards. Offline viewers see it after joining.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `player` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | viewer, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### removeViewer {#removeviewer}

::: member

Removes a viewer; a private display disappears for that player.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `player` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | viewer, not null |

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::

### clearViewers {#clearviewers}

::: member

Removes every viewer; a private display disappears for everyone.

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — this display

:::
